origin: User-provided local Jianying tutorial; abstracted principles, not a bundled preset.

techniques.name: 校正识别文字后分段生成配音
techniques.intent: 从原讲话提取并校正内容，再由指定语音引擎重新朗读。

operations.approval_basis: actual audition or supplied authoritative text

timing.rule: Generated sample duration is measured, not assumed equal to original caption duration. Resolve overlaps and visual timing after synthesis.

pitfalls: This is speech resynthesis from text, not a demonstrated pitch/voice conversion of original audio.
The tutorial's claim that小姐姐isSiri is not verified by this review and does not establish voice identity.
A historical UI voice name does not guarantee present availability or offline support.
ASR errors become spoken errors if not corrected.
Independent TTS clips can exceed their source caption windows and overlap; screenshot layering does not prove correct audio timing.
validation: Verify exact text and pronunciation, especially names and foreign terms, by audition.
Measure generated durations and check overlaps/gaps against the intended narration schedule.
Use only a configured available engine/voice and retain provider/asset provenance.
Audition the actual voice before claiming any named-voice similarity.

techniques.name: 替换配音时关闭原声并独立控制字幕显示
techniques.intent: 避免原讲话与新配音重复播放，字幕显示不决定配音是否保留。

operations.tracks: generated clips only plus explicitly allowed audio

timing.rule: Mute original throughout the replacement narration scope; caption visibility is separate from the persistent generated-audio asset reference.

pitfalls: Muting preview UI is not sufficient unless the render audio bus also applies gain0.
Deleting a linked caption in some editors may affect generated audio; code should model visibility and asset ownership explicitly.
Remaining source sound must follow the confirmed audio policy rather than be restored accidentally.
validation: Verify original track gain0 in rendered audio routing.
Audition for doubled speech, overlap and clipping.
Changing caption visibility leaves narration sample content and timing unchanged when intended.

unknowns: No audio audition or continuous playback performed.
ASR is unverified, including spoken comparison between original and the allegedSiri voice.
Exact voice model, voice identity, provider terms and current UI availability are unknown.
The lesson demonstrates only part of its caption set; it does not show generating every caption's voice to completion.
